description: Expected structure for security_audit.json. All fields are required. Populate each field with the correct value derived from your analysis of the PDDB image and configuration.

duplicate_pairs.basis: str — basis the pair belongs to

integrity_analysis.per_entry_false_positive_rate: float — probability that a single entry decrypted under an incorrect key passes the integrity check by chance
integrity_analysis.expected_false_positives_per_credential: float — expected number of false positives when testing one incorrect credential against all page table entries

per_basis_collision_probability.<basis_name>: float — theoretical probability of at least one nonce collision within this basis

cross_basis_collision_probability.<basisA_vs_basisB>: float — theoretical probability of at least one nonce value appearing in both bases

actual_nonce_collisions.basis: str — basis where collision was observed

fscb_deniability.unknown_pages: int — page table entries not attributable to any discovered basis
fscb_deniability.confirmed_free: int — entries confirmed free by the current FSCB
fscb_deniability.max_potentially_hidden: int — upper bound on entries that could belong to undiscovered bases
fscb_deniability.deniability_ratio: float — ratio of confirmed free pages to unknown pages

fscb_differential.transitioned_from_free: int — pages present in previous FSCB but absent from current FSCB
fscb_differential.attributable_to_known_bases: int — transitioned pages now belonging to discovered bases
fscb_differential.unattributable_transitions: int — transitioned pages not belonging to any discovered basis
fscb_differential.leaked_hidden_activity: bool — whether any unattributable transitions exist
